text.en: Find the notes of line 1: each one waits until you're on it.

In Burleigh's setting the altos sing the tune. The sopranos wait eight bars, then float a slow "Deep, deep river" above the altos' second time through. In the verse both sing the tune together, until the sopranos climb alone on "That promised land".

source.en: H. T. Burleigh, Deep River, for mixed voices (New York: G. Schirmer, 1914), pp. 1 to 3, read from the scan

Deep River was first mentioned in print in 1876, in the first edition of J. B. T. Marsh's The Story of the Jubilee Singers, with Their Songs.
